title: One equity lot, partial long-term sale after 23-Jul-2024, gain inside the Rs 1.25 lakh s.112A threshold
rules: Income-tax Act 1961 s.2(42A) first proviso (listed equity share): short-term if held not more than 12 months; period counted excluding the day of acquisition (General Clauses Act 1897 s.9)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.48: gain = full value of consideration - transfer expenses - cost of acquisition (incl. acquisition expenses)
Income-tax Act 1961 s.112A(1) as amended by Finance (No.2) Act 2024 (No.15 of 2024): LTCG exceeding Rs 1,25,000 taxed at 12.5 % for transfers on/after 23-Jul-2024
CBDT Circular No. 768 dated 24-Jun-1998: FIFO for demat shares
Health and Education Cess 4 % of tax (Finance Act 2018 s.2(11); continued by Finance (No.2) Act 2024 s.2)
derivation: FIFO: all 60 from the 2023-05-10 lot; cost 60 x 50 = 3,000.00. No fmv_2018 -> tax_cost = 3,000.00.
Gain 4,800 - 3,000 = 1,800.00, STT paid both legs -> s.112A, transfer on/after 23-Jul-2024 -> 12.5 %.
FY 2024-25 (fy 2025): total s.112A LTCG 1,800 <= 1,25,000 -> exemption_used 1,800.00, taxable 0 -> tax 0.00, cess 0.00, total 0.00.
